text:
jules (PM): quick thread — BankingPilot asks for a mid-tier offering: route-level QoS tokens, purchasable minute-blocks for peak windows, and a soft-SLA credit mechanic. they want predictability but won’t sign up for Dedicated. can we sketch an implementable path?
eva (AE): theyre willing to commit monthly ARR but no GPU reservations. must-have: predictable capacity for two named routes and a clear, measurable remedy if latency or throughput drops.
kiran (Pricing): product levers Id use: per-route QoS token buckets billed per-minute; minute-block packs (e.g., 1k/5k/10k priority-min packs); and a monthly priority cap to limit spend. commercial model = commit + token consumption premium. need a short unit-econ spike.
ryan (Infra): feasibility notes: runtime can honor a priority flag + per-route token bucket; hard GPU isolation requires Dedicated. minute-block billing needs low-latency event emission to billing; otherwise we get lag and customer confusion. KV prefix pinning for hot prefixes possible but needs eviction and telemetry.
bea (Legal): if we promise any SLA-like remedy we must define measurement windows, a deterministic credit calculation, caps (percent of monthly commit), and exclusions (maintenance, force majeure, abuse). also flag: BankingPilot requires EU-data locality for those routes — addendum required.
jules (PM): proposed pilot: "midway-qos beta" (4-week alpha with one customer) — scope:
- route-level QoS token buckets (soft guarantees)
- purchasable minute-blocks consumed when route marked priority
- automatic downgrade to baseline model variant when tokens exhausted
- soft-SLA credit formula: credit = sum(over minutes where p99 > target) * credit_unit; cap = min(monthly commit * 0.2, $cap)
Please react with issues or missing items.
eva (AE): sales supports pilot. BankingPilot accepts a non-binding pilot SLA if SLOs are concrete and instrumented. they asked that priority be limited to explicit route_ids only.
kiran (Pricing): +1. acceptance criteria from pricing: baseline token unit-econ, estimated average and peak priority-minute consumption, and a recommended per-1k-minute price band. also propose a per-customer monthly cap and an emergency shutoff for runaway usage.
ryan (Infra): eng acceptance criteria: 1) runtime honors per-route token buckets + priority path, 2) minute-block meter emits near-real-time events, 3) KV pinning MVP with memory caps and eviction rules, 4) feature-flag rollout and canary. estimate: 1 spike week + 2 sprints to pilot-ready.
bea (Legal): pilot T&C items: measurement method (p99 over 1m windows), credit cap = min(monthly commit, 25%), carve-outs for scheduled maintenance, and an EU data residency addendum. Ill draft pilot language and an addendum.
jules (PM): quick pricing placeholders (kiran confirm): +12% token uplift for priority-minute consumption, +30% for exclusive surge windows, and minute-block discounts at larger packs. placeholders until eng cost delta.
kiran (Pricing): noted. will run three scenarios (low/typical/heavy) and return recommended bands and a sensitivity table.
eva (AE): BankingPilot wants the admin to tag which route_ids can consume priority tokens. confirm we can enforce that?
ryan (Infra): yes — enforcement by route_id + token bucket. API param and console toggle. if route uses more than allowed, return 429 and optionally deduct from minute-block if available.
jules (PM): pilot success metrics & GA gate suggestions:
- technical: p99 baseline routes increase <= 15% vs baseline under pilot load
- commercial: pilot incremental MRR uplift >= 11% net of incremental cost
- support: <= X support tickets/week attributable to priority behavior (TBD)
- observability: per-route token burn, p50/p95/p99, cost delta in console
kiran (Pricing): Id add an economic safety gate: expected gross margin on priority consumption >= target margin otherwise we don't GA.
bea (Legal): add requirement: any GA expansion with public SLA language requires a liability review and sign-off from Legal + Security.
deploy-bot: reminder set: "midway-qos pilot kickoff" 2026-05-20 14:00 UTC
jules (PM): action items:
- ryan: spike + short design doc for token buckets, minute-meter, and KV pinning (due 7d)
- bea: draft pilot T&C + EU addendum (due 3d)
- kiran: pricing scenarios and unit-econ (due 5d)
- eva: secure written pilot acceptance and list of route_ids (due 2d)
- jules: pilot console mock + checklist (due 3d)
eva (AE): will send the signed pilot acceptance and the two route_ids by EOD.
ryan (Infra): will post the spike results and perf numbers after week. expecting memory/cost delta numbers.
kiran (Pricing): will share a scenario spreadsheet and recommended bands mid-week.
bea (Legal): will circulate a compact pilot clause for quick sign-off; will call out credit formula and cap.
jules (PM): thanks all — plan to reconvene after the spike. keep notes short in the design doc so we can hand to a solutions engineer for onboarding. :thumbsup:
